question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: "To leave suddenly and hurriedly".
solution: The correct answer is **'Option(1)' i.e. 'Abscond'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Abscond"** means to leave hurriedly and secretly, especially to avoid arrest or legal action. (फरार होना) • **Example: **The accused tried to abscond after committing the crime. • **"Abscond"** correctly describes leaving suddenly and in haste. (जल्दी से भाग जाना) • **Example: **He absconded from the office without informing anyone. • The term is generally used in legal or criminal contexts. Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Perambulate** (टहलना): To walk through or around a place. • **Circumambulate** (परिक्रमा करना): To walk all the way around something, especially in a ritual manner. • **Loiter** (आवारा घूमना): To stand or wait around without purpose. 3c:T95a, The correct answer is **Option 2.**
